title: A2SP: Asymmetric Two-Step Pairing framework toolkit
description: Reference implementation of the Asymmetric Two-Step Pairing (A2SP) framework: one pairing kernel, any domain. Every A2SP channel rate carries a common carrier factor that cancels exactly in the reduced trajectory equations dY/dX = -1 + kappa*Y/X (resonance line kappa = 1), leaving closed-form, fit-free laws. The kernel source is the unified theory of generalized AA+BB step-growth polymerization (Q. Tang, JACS submission; ChemRxiv preprint 10.26434/chemrxiv.15009468/v1); the first application is two-stage rumor spreading (Maki-Thompson cascade). The toolkit ships two runnable examples (rumor model: mean-field ODEs, Gillespie SSA, configuration-model network cascade; step-growth polymerization: reduced trajectories, terminal arrest, published regression anchors), 53 regression tests (23 published-anchor, 3 stochastic smoke, 27 audit/verification), and stochastic engines with recorded seeds for reproducibility.
